answer: Make each identity carry its own relic: at registration, the agent's key seeds a unique 50 GB dataset it must keep sealed on its own disk. Each epoch a zephyr of random spot-checks asks for a few chunks with a two-second deadline, too short to regenerate them on demand. Because every dataset is derived from a different key, one operator cannot dedupe storage across a thousand fakes; each clone needs its own 50 GB. An honest agent keeps one small oasis of storage, while a farm pays per head. (Sizes illustrative.)
